own_solution.law: Kinetic-theory collision frequency z = sqrt(2) pi d^2 n v_mean, with n = P/(kT) and v_mean = sqrt(8kT/(pi m))

defect_reasons.other: T8E4F ('Just before the collisions were counted ... for one run only') does not make clear whether that run is the one asked about; I read it as the counted run (R), but a D reading is possible.

notes: n = 80000/(1.381e-23*300) = 1.9310e25 m^-3; sqrt(2) pi d^2 = 6.0823e-19 m^2; m = 4.6495e-26 kg; v_mean = sqrt(8kT/(pi m)) = 476.35 m/s; z = 5.5946e9 s^-1. With 33 kPa more nitrogen at 300 K in the rigid vessel: P = 113 kPa, z = 5.5946e9*113/80 = 7.9024e9 s^-1. Volume cancels (n = N/V = P/kT): C. Gas-cylinder sentences and earlier-experiment sentences: D. Numbers consistent across variants (33 kPa, 5.2 L). The atomic mass unit value is not given; standard 1.66054e-27 kg used.
